name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: Spotlight card for vertical reels: a soft light spot drifts across a dark brand card while a blurred light mesh breathes behind it. Brand palette, Montserrat 28-44 px, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it with data-composition-src on a host with data-composition-id="spotlight-card", once for each place it plays.
